body:
No static typing in the class reference. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99925
```suggestion
			    var code_edit = Engine.get_main_loop().root.get_node(paths[0]);
```
Although https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99925 was merged as is, I showed concern in [removing some cases like this](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99925/files#r1866011484), where it's done to narrow down the type (from generic Node to CodeEdit in this case).
